# pd-neut-tof_ncaf-wish-5bank_scan-6p — provenance

**Source project.** `docs/user/cli/pd-neut-tof_ncaf-wish-5bank_start-fullprof/project` (FullProf's converged
five-bank Na<sub>2</sub>Ca<sub>3</sub>Al<sub>2</sub>F<sub>14</sub> refinement), copied unchanged except
`analysis/analysis.edi`, which declares the series.

**Data.** Generated by crysta's `tools/datagen/build_seeded_series.py`:

```bash
python tools/datagen/build_seeded_series.py \
    docs/user/cli/pd-neut-tof_ncaf-wish-5bank_start-fullprof/project OUT --points 6 --crysta CRYSTA_CLI
```

with its defaults: point k (0 to 5) is the source project calculated by the crysta command line with every cell length
× (1 + 2·10⁻⁵ k) and bank b's scale × (1 + 0.002 k (b + 1) / 5), banks in name order, plus Gaussian noise of each
point's measured s.u. from seed 20261115. Each `data/p00k_<bank>.xye` holds `x y su` for the points the source
project fits (excluded regions left out). The generated `analysis/analysis.edi` was then given
`_minimizer.descent fast_descent`.

**Expected values.** `n_free` is the source project's free set (`kind: reference`, the count FullProf's input frees).
Every per-point χ² and iteration count is a regression pin of `python -m edi fit` of this project (`kind:
regression-pin`). Generated data check the fit against itself, never against an independent program.
